SELECT me.name AS member_name, partner.name AS partner_name,
cr.total_score,
cr.asset_stability_score, r.asset_stability_reason,
cr.debt_repayment_score, r.debt_repayment_reason,
cr.financial_value_score, r.financial_value_reason,
cr.goal_feasibility_score, r.goal_feasibility_reason, r.expected_asset,
cr.tax_strategy_score, r.tax_strategy_reason,
cs.target_amount, cs.target_period_months AS target_months, cs.loan_purpose,
me.investment_type AS investment_profile_me, partner.investment_type AS investment_profile_you, c.investment_type AS investment_profile_we
FROM member me INNER JOIN couple c ON c.inviter_id = me.id OR c.invitee_id = me.id INNER JOIN member partner ON partner.id = CASE WHEN c.inviter_id = me.id THEN c.invitee_id ELSE c.inviter_id END INNER JOIN compatibility_result cr ON cr.couple_id = c.id INNER JOIN report r ON r.compatibility_result_id = cr.id INNER JOIN invitation_code ic ON ic.id = c.invitation_code_id INNER JOIN common_survey cs ON cs.id = ic.common_survey_id WHERE me.id = #{memberId}
